title: Remove the old UI at /classic
request: List what /classic can do that the product cannot; build each item in the product with existing components or confirm with the owner that it is dropped; then remove the /classic route and the old files, keep static/app, and update the tests and CLAUDE.md. The owner decided to drop the old UI and keep research campaigns on the command line.
spec: An inventory of what only the old UI did; each item built or confirmed dropped; the route and its files removed; tests and docs updated.
plan: Have an explorer inventory the old UI: its 16 files, what serves and links to them, the API routes only it used, and the docs that mention it.
Remove the route, the 16 files, its public page-shell entry, Compute's 'Open in the classic UI' link and the stale Playwright script that drove the old page.
Update the tests to check /classic and its files answer 404 and that the research map is on the Lab page.
Run the gate and the reviewer; build the lost features it found; fix the docs; re-review; fix the last display bug.

decisions.decision: Research campaigns stay on the command line (python -m dclab_rnd.agentic run|resume).
decisions.why: The owner decided; the only real gap was starting, pausing and resuming campaigns.
The command line, the Jobs page's export link and API users read them.

change: Removed /classic, its 16 files under agentic/static/{index.html,css,js}, its page-shell entry, Compute's link to it and a stale Playwright script; built in the product: delete a project (Workflow page) and an intern session (Sessions tab) behind confirm dialogs, a link to the field guide /guide on Evidence, each research trial's files and the resume command on Compute's job detail.

findings.defect: Features only the old UI had were lost without the owner agreeing, and the row said everything had an equivalent.
findings.scenario: In the product there was no control to delete a project or an intern session, no link to the field guide /guide, and no download of a research run's per-trial files; package 12.5 promises project deletion with an audit entry, and Admin offers 'until the project is deleted'.
findings.cause: The inventory looked for the big gap (campaigns) and missed small actions.
findings.fix: A Delete button on the Workflow page for a real project that is not running, 'Delete the open session' on the Sessions tab, an Evidence link to /guide, and each trial's result, recipe and out-of-fold predictions on Compute's job detail; the Knowledge view is listed as moved to the API.
findings.test: tests/test_pages_ops.py checks a trial file is listed and downloads; the buttons and the link were checked in a browser.

findings.defect: A research job on Compute could not be acted on, and the page did not say how.
findings.scenario: A paused, interrupted or failed research row showed only a trajectory download; neither the page nor the row said that runs resume from the command line or that Ctrl+C pauses one.
findings.cause: The control moved to the command line without a pointer.
findings.fix: The job detail gives 'python -m dclab_rnd.agentic resume <run_id>' for a paused, interrupted or failed run, and otherwise says how runs start and that Ctrl+C pauses one.
findings.test: tests/test_pages_ops.py checks the note names the command.

findings.defect: Docs still described the old UI.
findings.scenario: README listed the Knowledge and Agent campaigns pages and links like #map/... and #run/... that the product sends to Home; it pointed to a deleted intern view; the Makefile's agent-serve help and a research README said the web UI starts campaigns.
findings.cause: Docs outside the package's file list.
findings.fix: The README describes the Lab, Evidence and Compute pages and the current intern view; agent-serve's help and the research README say campaigns use the command line.

findings.defect: The project delete dialog escaped the name twice.
findings.scenario: A project named "Bob's churn" showed as 'Delete “Bob's churn”?', and 'Q&A' as 'Q&A', because the title was escaped before a dialog that already sets it as text.
findings.cause: Escaping for HTML a value that is inserted as text.
findings.fix: Pass the plain name; both delete dialogs got a red confirm button.

findings.defect: The 8.3 commit was folded into the 8.4 commit.
findings.scenario: A failed git add stopped the 8.3 commit; the 8.4 commit that followed took every staged change, so 8.3's work landed under 8.4's message. main refuses force-pushes, so it could not be rewritten.
findings.cause: Committing without checking that the previous commit succeeded.
findings.fix: An empty follow-up commit records what the 8.4 commit also contains for 8.3.

outcome: Done: /classic and its files are gone, the four features only it offered are in the product, Compute says how to resume a research run, and tests check the old route and files answer 404. Reviewed: four findings, then one, all fixed.
lessons: An inventory before a removal must list small actions (delete, links, downloads), not only the headline feature.
Escape for the sink: text set with textContent must not be HTML-escaped first.
After a failed commit step, check git status before the next commit.
